name: better-agent-messaging
description: Mid-task messaging for Claude Code agent teams: SendMessage reaches a running teammate at its next step, plus hold, standing orders, broadcast and live agent status.

staleMinutes.title: Stale after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: An agent with no step and no tool in flight for this long is reported as stale.

toolStaleMinutes.title: Long tool after (minutes)
toolStaleMinutes.description: An agent stuck in one tool call for this long is reported.

shipPattern.title: Ship actions (regex)
shipPattern.description: Extra Bash commands that `hold ship:` refuses, as a regular expression. The built-in list (git push, PR merge, releases, publish, deploy, rm -rf) always applies.

trace.title: Trace
trace.description: Write every decision the mod makes to ~/.claude/better-agent-messaging/trace/ for debugging.
